title: How are you guys getting these gorgeous landscapes I'm seeing for open world games?
author: horsewitnoname
selftext:
Hey everyone!

  
I've got two games currently in development; the first an RTS that is in the polish and bug fixing phase, and a multilayer open world RPG that is still in active dev. 

I'm using Claude Code Opus 5.5 with the direct connections to Blender, but I've been really disappointed with the landscapes it has been producing as well as the animations for character movement and attacks.

What does you pipeline look like for creating these gorgeous open worlds I'm seeing all over YouTube and the nice looking animations I'm seeing for characters. Admittedly I haven't given them a full design doc for landscapes yet, I've been too focused on gameplay first, but I kind of still expected more from the tool itself with just a couple reference sentences I gave it.

I've almost completely given up on having it make good animations tbh, I keep getting really bad ones.

Would love to hear from you guys that are in the same boat and have gotten some really good outputs!

Thanks in advance!
